en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a small European village with pitched‑roof houses, tree‑lined dirt streets, gardens, and fields stretching toward low hills in the background. The village name "Brockwitz" is printed in red script at the bottom center, while at the lower left in small type it reads "Brück & Sohn, Meissen." A red handwritten number "1245" appears at the top right.
